tips.text: Refine the Blueprint and Systems relics to Radiant; leave Neuroptics and Chassis relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds.
Squad up with players cracking the same Radiant relics to raise your odds on the Uncommon and Rare parts.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Buy extra Blueprint relics; every one carries it as the Rare.
Buy her relics from the Market console on your Orbiter to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
